question: Which of the following National Highway passes through the Kaziranga National Park is imposing key threat for the wildlife?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NH-37.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Centre is making plans to assemble a flyover over countrywide highway** 37 (NH 37) **that passes through Kaziranga National Park in Assam.
 
• **The Kaziranga countrywide Park** is traversed via national toll road 37.
